title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity across python/typescript/go and bump v1.98.0
author: Maya Patel
description: Unify SDK behavior for authentication, retry semantics, and streaming APIs across Python/TypeScript/Go. This PR harmonizes auth token refresh, standardizes retry/backoff (idempotency-aware defaults), and aligns streaming client ergonomics so host applications see consistent connection lifecycle and error callbacks. Also includes small parity fixes (TS/Go missing headers for server-sent events), documentation updates and test coverage, and a coordinated version bump to v1.98.0 across all SDKs. Motivation: reduce cross-language surprises for integrators, unblock Dedicated customers experiencing token refresh races, and prepare for upcoming streaming diagnostics feature. Changes prioritized to be backward-compatible; migration notes included for callers that relied on previous non-deterministic retry timing.
commits: feat(python): add TokenRefresher helper + ensure single-flight refresh
feat(ts): streaming client: expose onReconnect and standardized close codes
feat(go): retry middleware: idempotency-key header automatic preservation
fix(ts): sse transport include Authorization header for edge proxies
test: add cross-sdk integration tests for stream reconnect and retry behavior
chore: bump versions to v1.98.0 and update changelogs

release_notes: SDKs: Unify authentication token refresh behavior across Python/TS/Go - reduces token races and double-refresh calls.
SDKs: Standardize retry/backoff policy with idempotency-aware defaults; callers that set custom retry middleware should verify preserved idempotency header behavior.
SDKs: Streaming client parity: onReconnect and deterministic close codes added to TS/Go to match Python ergonomics.
Bugfix: ensure Authorization header is sent for SSE transports (fixes edge proxy issues).
